description: This file defines the ModifyPolicyEntry class, which represents an immutable command used to modify a PolicyEntry within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for policy-related data.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntry
classes.description: An immutable command class for modifying a PolicyEntry in the policy management system, supporting JSON serialization, deserialization, and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method for creating a ModifyPolicyEntry instance with a PolicyId, PolicyEntry, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a ModifyPolicyEntry from a JSON string or JSON object with headers.

methods.name: getPolicyEntry
methods.description: Accessor returning the PolicyEntry to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JSON representation of the PolicyEntry, conforming to the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds and returns the JSON pointer path to the specific policy entry being modified.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for this command by appending relevant fields.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifyPolicyEntry with updated Ditto headers.
